messages:
marta: Heads-up: QA found inconsistent term usage and mixed-casing in SDK examples across the 'getting-started' and 'api-reference' pages. Can we do a focused pass?

owen: Happy to help. Suggestion: one small PR per section (tutorials, refs, SDK snippets) so reviewers can digest.

marta: Good call. Basic rules I want enforced: 1) product name first use 'Redwood Inference', afterwards 'Redwood'; 2) glossary terms lowercased in body (e.g., 'model variant'); 3) code params match language conventions.

ria: For code params: JS -> lowerCamelCase, Python -> snake_case. I'll make a tiny lint script to flag mismatches.

stylebot: New lint rule queued: docs-snippet-casing (flags parameter names that don't match language mapping).

owen: Also note: some error messages in the API ref say "please contact support". Per style we remove 'please' from machine-facing messages. Ria, can your grep also list these?

ria: Yup. I'll run grep and post the file list here. Plan: open PRs with only textual edits (no behavior or telemetry changes).

marta: When changing any string that might appear in logs or telemetry, call out in the PR description that we did not rename keys. Only human-facing text changed.

owen: Add migration blurb to the docs release notes so customers searching for old examples can find the change.

stylebot: Reminder: PR template now includes 'snippet casing confirmed' checkbox.

marta: OK team, small surgical pass. Ria, ping when the file list is ready and we'll split into 3 PRs. :white_check_mark:
